# EFI Variable Commands for Redfish Configuration
# Generated by configure-redfish-client.sh
# Configuration Type: simulator
#
# Use these commands in the EFI Shell to configure Redfish service settings

# Method 1: Using RedfishPlatformConfig.efi application
RedfishPlatformConfig.efi -s 127.0.0.0 255.255.255.0 127.0.0.1 255.255.255.0 5000

# Method 2: Manual variable setting (if RedfishPlatformConfig.efi is not available)
# Note: These are raw setvar commands - USE WITH CAUTION

# Service endpoint configuration
setvar HostIpAssignmentType -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =01
setvar HostIpAddress -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =7f 00 00 00
setvar HostIpMask -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =ff ff ff 00
setvar RedfishServiceIpAddress -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =7f 00 00 01
setvar RedfishServiceIpMask -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =ff ff ff 00
setvar RedfishServiceIpPort -guid 84A67BD6-AC91-4F3C-AA5A-A89D82FD4E96 -bs -nv =88 13

# Restart the system after setting variables for changes to take effect
reset
